overview.description: The Global X PureCap MSCI Energy ETF (GXPE) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MSCI USA / Energy index. The fund selects US companies involved in the Energy sector. Holdings are weighted purely by market capitalization without maximum weight constraints. GXPE was launched on Jul 22, 2025 and is issued by Global X.
